NAME: Charlotte
TEXT: This beautiful blue girl is friendly and affectionate. She is happy to meet new people, new critters. Charlotte also enjoys a walk and is very easy to walk with on the lead. She would be a great addition to your life since she is such good company and easy going.

NAME: Ben
TEXT: Meet Ben – Your Fun-Loving Foodie! If you’re looking for a happy, outgoing companion with plenty of personality, Ben could be your perfect match. Full of playful, puppy-like energy, Ben loves nothing more than stretching his legs, chasing toys, and making the most of every adventure. Like his brother Bill, Ben never raced and has spent his life living in an apartment with a differently abled owner alongside another dog, so he has experience as a much-loved companion in a home environment. He’s friendly, social, and enjoys being involved in whatever his people are doing. One thing you’ll quickly discover about Ben is his enthusiasm for food! He absolutely loves mealtimes and tasty treats, making him a delight to train and an eager participant in learning new things. With his affectionate nature, playful spirit, and love of life, Ben would thrive with an active family or individual who can give him plenty of exercise, enrichment, and, of course, a few delicious snacks along the way. If you’re after a cheerful best friend who will keep you smiling every day, Ben is ready to meet you.

NAME: Cherie
TEXT: Meet Cherie, a sweet and gentle girl with a calm, easy going nature. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, it doesn't take long for her confidence to shine through. Once she feels comfortable, Cherie is affectionate, playful and loves spending time with her people. She enjoys playtime, walks beautifully on lead and has a relaxed, no nonsense personality that makes her a delight to have around the home. Cherie would be well suited to a young family looking for a loyal and gentle companion who will reward a little patience with endless love and companionship.

NAME: Merle
TEXT: Meet Merle 💛 Merle is a sweet, gentle girl with a kind nature who is looking for a calm, understanding home where she can truly blossom. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, once you've earned her trust, she'll reward you with quiet loyalty and plenty of love. She loves spending time outdoors, whether she's playing with a ball, relaxing in the sunshine, or enjoying the company of her German Shepherd friend. Merle has also been enjoying her walks and is happy passing dogs of all sizes. Merle has been wonderful with visiting grandchildren aged 10 and over who understand how to give her space and let her come to them. A calm, predictable environment with gentle introductions to new experiences will help her continue to build confidence. Merle would thrive in a quieter home with patient adopters who are happy to let her settle in at her own pace. She enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and is perfectly content quietly exploring her surroundings or could happily share her home with a friendly medium-large canine companion. 🐾❤️

NAME: Yazzi
TEXT: This dynamic girl is very social and confident, she has had exposure to farm animals and the odd visit from the local native critters. Since she is so confident and social she would adjust to many different lifestyles.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear, Bear is an adorable young Greyhound with a happy, friendly nature that's hard not to love. He's a real people dog and is always keen to come over for a hello, greeting everyone with loose, wiggly body and plenty of enthusiasm. Bear has a playful side and has a great time running around the yard with his toys. He enjoys exploring, having fun and making the most of his time outside before happily settling again. On walks, Bear is easy to handle and has lovely manners on lead. He enjoys taking in his surroundings with plenty of sniffing and exploring but stays polite and relaxed while doing so. Around other Greyhounds, Bear has shown calm, friendly social skills, offering gentle sniffs and interacting politely. Meet Bear at Western Sydney.

NAME: Kelly
TEXT: Meet Kelly, Kelly is a lovely girl with a fun, gentle nature. She loves people and really soaks up any attention she's given! Toys are one of Kelly's favourite things. She loves carrying them around, playing games and will often bring them back to you for another throw. She's confident, curious and enjoys being involved in whatever is going on. On lead, Kelly is polite and easy to handle. She moves calmly around other dogs and has shown appropriate social skills. When meeting other dogs, she has shown good manners, offering polite sniffs and responding well to gentle guidance to move on. If you're looking for a friendly, playful Greyhound with great manners, Kelly is an easy dog to fall in love with. She'll happily join you for a walk, enjoy a play with her toys, then settle down nearby, ready for the next bit of attention.

NAME: Bill
TEXT: Meet Bill – Your Adventure Buddy! If you’re looking for a fun-loving companion with a zest for life, Bill is ready to steal your heart. This handsome boy is full of playful, puppy-like energy and absolutely loves stretching his legs with a good run or chasing after his favourite toys. Bill is friendly, outgoing, and thrives on being part of the action. His confident, extroverted nature means he’s always keen to make new friends and join in on whatever you’re doing. Whether it’s an adventure outdoors or a game in the backyard, Bill is happiest when he’s active and spending time with his people. Unlike many greyhounds, Bill has never raced. He’s enjoyed life as a much-loved companion, living successfully in an apartment with a differently abled owner and another dog. This experience has given him excellent house manners and shown that he can adapt beautifully to home life. Bill would love a family who can match his enthusiasm for life and provide him with plenty of opportunities to play, explore, and, of course, chase a toy or two. In return, you’ll gain a loyal, affectionate companion who will bring endless fun and smiles to every day.

NAME: Simon
TEXT: Simon is in foster care & available to adopt! Our foster care superstar Simon is a beautifully natured greyhound who is currently living with 2 greyhounds and small dogs (cavoodles). Simon would love an adults only home, with a townhouse/backyard to enjoy. He requires a multi-dog household to keep his confidence growing. He is shy by nature, and would love a structured home, in a quiet area (he is currently in suburban South Sydney). A home with maximum 2 adults is required as a busier home with lots of humans is an overwhelming thing for Simon. Simon will take some time to trust you, as he took a few weeks to trust his foster carers. Simon has grown his confidence around busier areas while being on a dual lead with the other greyhound, so he definitely needs a doggie friend/s by his side. Simon still gets spooked by loud noises, but can shake it off and carry on now that he has spent longer in foster and has his dog friend with him. He seeks comfort from the other greyhounds, so a home with a greyhound (or a greyhound and other breeds) is the best match. His foster carers leave Simon with the other dogs for their full time working schedule. A word from the fosters: "He understands that he needs to toilet outside, will take him outside after dinner, point down to the backyard and say “go toilet” and he will do it every night before we go to bed.. his toileting is excellent 10/10, can’t fault it (don’t think there’s been a single accident in the house since he first came to us.) He’s not afraid to approach Erin or myself for a pat, when we first had him here, he wouldn’t come near me when I would get home from work, would always be standing in the background while I gave love to Wanda, Finn & Coast.. now he’s trying to push through them all trying to get love from me and I love it!, sometimes he now even sleeps on the bed with us of a night. Simon has shown us that he’s fine around 2-3 people, but I feel he does find large groups of people overwhelming. Simon does get on perfectly fine with Wanda, Finn and Coast and has no problem sharing his space with them, has shown no signs of aggression whatsoever towards any of them. His new people will need to be patient with him, as he is on the shy side, he will take time to get comfortable in a new environment while he adjusts but once he comes out of his shell he will approach people for a pat/cuddle and is a very sweet/cute boy." Simon is a beautiful boy who has really come out of his shell with us and has come a long way since he first came to us.. he doing so well! 😊 If you're a quiet, understanding home with greyhound experience, another greyhound/others, enquire to meet Simon by appointment (with his foster family) at Western Sydney.

NAME: Joany
TEXT: Joany is a beautiful, small, young girl who is truly a sweet bundle of joy. She is bubbly, affectionate, and would be suitable to live with respectful children. She loves spending time with people, happily soaking up pats, affection, and companionship. Shorter hours alone is best suited. Joany is an affectionate girl who enjoys being involved in everyday life and will quickly charm everyone she meets with her playful and happy personality. She has shown good toilet manners. Joany is social with M-L breed dogs making her a lovely companion for a multi-dog household. One of her favourite things is letting loose and doing zoomies. With her affectionate nature, playful personality, Joany is ready to find a loving home where she can continue spreading happiness, cuddles, and zoomies every day. Book in to meet Joany in Western Sydney.

NAME: Tommy (Western Sydney)
TEXT: *Tommy has just gone to foster care in an apartment in the inner west and is available to adopt* Tommy is a gentle and sweet, shy boy who is polite around big and small dogs. Tommy is living in a foster care unit apartment, with stairs, and hours alone, in the inner west. He can be left alone for half days, and can work up to longer days. One of Tommy’s favourite things is having a cosy crate to retreat to. He happily walks into his crate on his own and settles quickly, making it a comforting and safe space for him. Tommy has a playful side too and absolutely loves toys. Whether it’s carrying them around or enjoying some quiet playtime, toys quickly bring out his happy and relaxed nature. With kindness, understanding, and a little patience, Tommy will reward his new family with loyalty, quiet companionship, and plenty of gentle affection. He has shown lovely manners in foster care & we can't wait to see him in his forever home with a family who adore him as much as his foster family. Meet Tommy at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rowdy
TEXT: Meet Rowdy! The handsome social butterfly with a heart full of love and a nose for treats. He is a dog social boy - friendly with big and small dogs and would enjoy a home with a medium to large dog. This confident and friendly guy absolutely adores people and will charm his way into your heart (and maybe your snack stash) in no time. Rowdy is super trainable and eager to learn, especially if food or toys are involved – a home that is interested in furthering his training and development is ideal. He’d thrive in a home with a yard to explore. Rowdy is available through our Western Sydney Adoption Centre.

NAME: Princess (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Princess is a very sweet, gentle greyhound who is still learning that the world can be a safe and predictable place. She truly wants to connect with people and be part of a home, and at times she may be a little unsure when things feel unfamiliar or overwhelming. With patience, routine, and kindness, her affectionate and trusting nature begins to shine through. She is very food motivated and enjoys engaging with toys, especially once she feels comfortable in her environment. These are wonderful tools for building confidence and strengthening her bond with her people over time. On leash, Princess can walk alongside other dogs and generally coexists well in shared spaces. She feels most comfortable with calm, respectful interactions and enjoys having clear, predictable boundaries when meeting other dogs, particularly around personal space. Princess would thrive in a home with outdoor access, as she finds open air spaces familiar and grounding. A quieter household will suit her best, as busy environments, loud noise, and high activity levels can feel overwhelming while she adjusts to life outside the kennels. She will benefit from time, space, and gentle guidance as she settles into home life. She could live with older, calmer children who understand the importance of giving her space and allowing her to approach interactions in her own time. At this stage, she would also prefer a home where someone is around most of the time, helping her feel secure during her transition. Princess is not a “rush in and settle immediately” kind of dog—but for the right person, she offers something very special: a rewarding journey as she grows into a relaxed and affectionate family member

NAME: Visco
TEXT: Meet Visco, Visco is a beautiful female Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature and a heart full of love to give. She is incredibly affectionate and enjoys being around people, happily approaching for pats, attention, and companionship. Her friendly personality makes her a wonderful companion for anyone looking for a relaxed and loving addition to their family. Visco is social with medium to large dogs and enjoys their company. While she doesn't need to live with another dog, she would happily share her home with a suitable canine companion, as she is calm and comfortable around other dogs. At home, Visco settles beautifully indoors and is content to relax by your side. Because of her easy-going nature, she could be well suited to apartment living in a quieter area. New environments can sometimes feel a little overwhelming for her, so she will do best with a family who can give her time to adjust and build confidence at her own pace. If you're searching for a sweet, affectionate Greyhound who loves human company, enjoys the presence of other dogs, and is happiest in a calm and caring home, Visco is ready to become someone's very special companion. Meet at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bang Bang
TEXT: Meet Bang Bang, don't let his name fool you- Bang Bang is a big, gentle soul and even bigger heart. This handsome black beauty is friendly, affectionate and loves spending time with his people. Bang Bang enjoys getting out for leisurely walks and is a pleasure to have on a lead, making him a wonderful companion for regular adventures. At home he just as happy stretching out in the backyard, soaking up the sunshine or relaxing after a stroll. He has interacted well with large dogs and older children, making him a great fit for a family looking for a calm, easy-going companion. with his gentle nature, handsome looks and a love for the simple things in life, Bang Bang is ready to become a much loved member of his forever family.

NAME: Microman
TEXT: Meet Microman, a charming little greyhound with a gentle soul. Microman is a shy boy when meeting new people, but once he feels safe and settled, his sweet, funny nature shines through. He forms strong bonds with those he trusts and loves being close to his people, including gentle kids 7+, especially when he can relax indoors or curl up in the comfort of his crate with his soft toys, which is his happy place. Like many greyhounds, Microman enjoys short bursts of playful energy, and one of his favourite things is playing with his fellow retired greyhounds or chasing a ball. He's social with other greys and would thrive in a home with a confident greyhound companion to help him feel secure and show him the ropes. He doesn't like baths much! Microman is looking for a quiet, patient household that will give him the time he needs to settle in and build confidence at his own pace. In return, you'll be rewarded with a loyal, affectionate and quirky companion who will keep you smiling with his funny antics.💛🐾

NAME: Lizzy
TEXT: Meet Lizzy! 🩷 Lizzy is a lovely greyhound with a sweet, easy-going personality that's sure to win hearts. She gets along wonderfully with other dogs and has been great with all of my dogs, making her a fantastic companion for a home with canine friends. She's relaxed and easy to walk on lead, enjoying gentle outings by your side without any fuss. Whether it's a stroll around the neighbourhood or a quiet day at home, Lizzy is happy just being with her people. Lizzy isn't suitable for a home with cats, so she'll need a feline-free family where she can thrive. If you're looking for a gentle, friendly Greyhound who is ready to settle into family life, Lizzy could be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Libby
TEXT: Meet Libby! 🖤 Libby is a beautiful black female Greyhound with a gentle nature and plenty of love to give. She walks beautifully on lead, making her a lovely companion for relaxed strolls and everyday adventures. She enjoys affection and will happily soak up plenty of pats and ear scratches from her favourite people. If you're looking for a sweet, calm companion who appreciates a little pampering, Libby could be the perfect match. Libby has met a cat and, with a slow and carefully managed introduction, has shown she may be able to live alongside a feline friend. As with any new pet relationship, patience and gradual introductions will help set everyone up for success. If you're searching for a kind-hearted Greyhound ready to become part of a loving family, Libby is waiting to meet you.

NAME: Jen
TEXT: Meet Jen, Jen is a wonderfully affectionate girl who absolutely adores people. Once she gets to know you, she's happiest curled up on the couch, usually lying across your lap. She's very people-focused and enjoys being close, soaking up pats and spending time together. Jen is looking for a home where she can be the only pet to soak up all of the attention. In quieter environments, Jen truly shines. She is more relaxed, highly engaged with her handler, and readily offers positive interactions, making it easy to see her sweet and affectionate personality. For someone looking for a devoted companion who loves nothing more than sharing the couch and being close to her people, Jen has so much love to give. She will thrive in a calm home that understands her needs and will be rewarded with an incredibly loyal, affectionate best friend. Book a meet at Western Sydney!

NAME: Britney
TEXT: Meet Britney, a beautiful little girl with the sweetest, gentle nature. Calm, affectionate and easy-going, Britney is happiest enjoying the simple things in life - being inside, lounging in the yard with her greyhound friends, soaking up some sunshine, or heading out for a leisurely walk. Britney can be a little shy when meeting new people, but in a short time quickly blossoms into a loving companion who adores gentle pats and being around her people. She is friendly by nature and has been great with children 7-12 years who understand how to give her a little space while she settles in. While she has the occasional playful bursts of energy, Britney is mostly a quiet, relaxed girl. She walks beautifully on lead and especially enjoys outings with her Staffy friend, making her a lovely walking companion. Britney is both house-trained and crate-trained and would thrive in a calm household where someone is home more often than not, or with a friendly medium to large canine companion.

NAME: Jack
TEXT: If you're looking for a BFG (Big Friendly Giant), meet Jack. He is 40 something kgs of love and pure charm. He is super friendly, loves any and all humans, and would be great for families. Older kids would be best suited as he is large and might forget his size during zoomies! He can happily live alongside another medium to large size dog, another dog with large dog breed experience (or another greyhound) would be a great fit, as he can be silly and inappropriate (we think he hasn't learnt he's the biggest dog in his cohort yet). Jack can live in a house/townhouse and doesn't mind a few hours alone as a solo pet per day, and could work up to longer with a dog friend and structure. This happy chat loves treats, training, and toys, and loves quiet moments of love with his humans. He has genuinely been a team favourite at the GAP HQ, because he will stand out in the crowd not only in size but with his handsome, charming nature. Meet Jack at Western Sydney.

NAME: Chester
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Chester 🐾 Chester is a handsome black Greyhound with a soft, gentle nature and a wonderfully easygoing presence. He’s the kind of boy who brings calm wherever he goes, happily trotting along through life with a relaxed outlook and a quietly affectionate heart. Sweet, sooky, and full of charm, Chester is a lovely companion who enjoys the simple pleasures in life. At home, Chester is a low-key, content boy who enjoys his downtime just as much as his little moments of activity. He’s known for his sweet quirks, like happily playing with his bowl after dinner, and he has a comforting, homely energy that makes him easy to be around. He even enjoys the background hum of a radio, adding to his cosy, relaxed lifestyle. Chester walks beautifully on lead and is naturally gentle, making him a pleasure to take out and about. He enjoys sniffing his surroundings, having a little trot and run, then settling back into an easy rhythm by your side. Travel is just as simple for him — he hops in, settles down, and takes everything in his stride. With people, Chester is affectionate and loving. He enjoys pats, leans in for attention, and has a soft, sooky way of connecting that makes him very endearing. He’s happiest when he’s close to his humans, sharing calm, relaxed moments together. When it comes to other dogs, Chester is a friendly boy who has experience walking alongside other Greyhounds and sharing space comfortably in familiar settings. On walks, he can be enthusiastic when meeting smaller dogs, and over time he settles nicely and is able to focus on his surroundings and enjoy his walk. In the home, he truly shines in a calm, steady environment where things feel predictable and peaceful. One of Chester’s lovely qualities is his gentle, easy nature combined with a playful spark showing his happy personality peeking through his calm exterior. 🏡 Chester’s Perfect Home Chester would love a calm, relaxed home where he can enjoy gentle walks, cosy downtime, and plenty of companionship with his people. He would thrive in a peaceful environment where life moves at an easy pace, whether with a couple, an individual, or a family with older, respectful children who enjoy a calm, affectionate dog. Chester would suit a home as the star of the show, or could also share his home with a calm, polite larger dog who matches his easygoing style. If you’re looking for a sweet, soft-hearted boy with a calm soul and a lot of love to give, Chester is ready to quietly steal your heart. 💛

NAME: Suzie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet… Suzie 🐾 Suzie is a gorgeous red fawn Greyhound girl with a bright, joyful spirit and a heart that loves connection. She has a happy, easygoing nature and a beautiful way of leaning in for affection, soaking up pats, and greeting her favourite people with big smiles and lots of love. She’s the kind of girl who makes you feel instantly at ease with her warm, friendly presence. Confident and curious, Suzie enjoys exploring the world. She likes to take in her surroundings and sniff out new adventures. Her outlook on life is relaxed and positive, making her a lovely companion for everyday outings and quiet moments alike. Suzie walks beautifully on lead, shifting between a light, easy tension and a relaxed slack lead as she enjoys her strolls. She’s comfortable in new environments and travels like a pro, settling calmly and comfortably when it’s time to rest and relax. People are absolutely Suzie’s favourite. She adores attention, happily comes over for pats, and often leans in close to soak up every bit of affection she can get. Her warm, social personality makes her a truly delightful companion who thrives on human connection. Suzie is happy to walk alongside calm, polite canine companions and can enjoy seeing other dogs while out and about. In her home life, though, she truly shines when she has her own space and can relax as the only dog, where she can fully unwind and enjoy being the centre of her family’s world. This is where her affectionate, easygoing nature really blossoms. 🏡 Suzie’s Perfect Home Suzie would love a loving home where she can enjoy walks, plenty of affection, and quality time with her humans. She would thrive in a calm environment where she can truly relax and shine, whether that’s with a couple, an individual, or a family with older, respectful children. Suzie would be happiest as the only dog with a family who appreciates her happy, friendly style. If you’re looking for a sweet, affectionate girl with a sunny personality and a whole lot of love to give, Suzie is ready to fill your home with warmth and joy. 💛

NAME: Pablo
TEXT: Pablo currently shares a yard with Missy without issue during the day, he walks great on the lead and is happy to meet new people and explore new places. He gets along with all dogs he meets and given his relaxed and laid back nature he could fit in to most living arrangments.

NAME: Missy
TEXT: This pretty girl is very sweet and affectionate. She is confident and inquisitive in new places and happy to make new friends. She currently lives well with Pablo in a residential yard.

NAME: Tammy Lynne
TEXT: This charming girl has been destined for pet life given her beautiful playful and affectionate nature, she gets along well with all people and children. She does well on her own, and is confident and social.

NAME: Bindi
TEXT: Affectionate, kind-hearted & active girl Bindi is looking for her forever home. Despite her age, she is all the things a young dog is: outgoing, ultra friendly and always smiling ear to ear. Bindi is the ideal companion, proving age is no barrier to affection and fun. A true toy enthusiast, Bindi absolutely loves playing and keeping herself entertained. Because of her excitement around toys, we recommend a home with children aged 10 years and over, as she may mistake a child's toys for her own during playtime! Bindi is social with other medium to large dogs and enjoys making canine friends, making her a wonderful companion for outings and adventures. She could happily live with an owner who works full-time, provided she has appropriate outlets for her energy, such as enrichment activities, interactive toys, and regular exercise before and after work. She is also well suited to apartment living, provided there is lift access or the apartment is on the ground floor. Bindi is showing no signs of slowing down any time soon! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ruby
TEXT: *I'm in a foster care home in a unit apartment & I am available to adopt* Ruby is a gentle, placid girl who is learning to be the best pet she can be in foster care. She fits perfectly into her new foster care home, conquering the staircases, showing off her perfect toilet training too! She’s very affectionate and enjoys being involved in whatever’s going on around her however she can be left alone successfully in her foster care home. She enjoys 3 walks a day and has shown great toilet training in foster care. She has also enjoyed being the GAP HQ office dog where she was perfectly behaved and charmed all the staff and visitors. She has continued this perfect behaviour in foster where she has never been destructive, or gotten into anything she shouldn't. She is a perfect office companion. She walks well on lead, has gone on bushwalks and street walks in foster, listens to cues & knows "no", too. Ruby is very food motivated and loves enrichment games and puzzle-style activities. She’s clever, confident, and enjoys figuring things out, especially if there’s food involved. With other dogs, Ruby prefers her own space and doesn’t tend to actively seek them out (but has paired nicely in the past). Older kids would be a great match for her affectionate side. Meet Ruby at Western Sydney!

NAME: Sally
TEXT: Meet Sally – a sweetheart looking for her forever home 🐶💖 Sally is an outgoing, friendly, and affectionate girl with a truly lovely nature. She’s gentle and respectful around children aged 6+, gets along well with small dogs (Mini Groodle and Kelpie cross), and has happily ignored the household cat (after slow introductions). Sally enjoys getting out and about and walks nicely on the lead once she gets going. She has short bursts of playful energy followed by a calm, relaxed side that loves to settle. At home, she adores her soft toys and is happiest when she can snuggle up inside with her people. Sally would be a wonderful match for an active family or a couple who enjoy spending time together and can give her the love and attention she thrives on. She’s a sweet companion who wants nothing more than to be part of your world. 🐾💕

NAME: Zippy
TEXT: Meet Zippy, a fun loving-boy with a real zest for life! Whether he's stretching his legs with a burst of zoomies, heading out for a walk or simply relaxing by your side, Zippy embraces everyday with enthusiasm. He just as happy spending time indoors as he is enjoying the outdoors, and he loves being with his people. While Zippy can be a little shy when meeting new faces, don't let that fool you. With a little patience and kindness, his gentle affectionate nature quickly shines through, rewarding you with a loyal companion who forms strong bonds and with those he trust. If you're looking for an active yet sensitive greyhound who will thrive in a loving home willing to let him settle in at his own pace, Zippy could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Mack
TEXT: Mack is a striking black and white gentleman who is ready to swap racing life for a loving home. After 24 starts on the track, he decided racing simply wasn’t for him anymore and is now looking forward to enjoying life at a much more relaxed pace. This sporty boy has a wonderful nature and is a pleasure to handle. He settles beautifully in his kennel, travels well in the car, and is comfortable being picked up and handled. Mack is friendly with people and loves to lean in for affection, making him a lovely companion to have by your side. On leash, Mack is calm and easy-going, enjoying his walks while staying attentive to his handler. He has lived and socialized well with other greyhounds and has shown sensible behavior around other dogs. When introduced through a fence to a barking Kelpie puppy, Mack calmly investigated, then chose to disengage and display appropriate calming behaviors rather than reacting. Mack does have a broken left canine tooth, but it doesn’t dampen his cheerful outlook on life. If you’re looking for a handsome, affectionate greyhound with excellent manners and a gentle temperament, consider adding Mack too your pack!

NAME: Katie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Katie 🐾 Sweet, gentle, and quietly endearing, Katie is a beautiful black greyhound with a soft presence and a loving heart that shines through once she feels comfortable. She has a delicate charm about her and a calm, steady way of moving through the world that makes her a lovely companion to be around. Katie is a sensitive sweetheart who enjoys connection with people at her own pace. While she may take a little time to settle into new surroundings, once she feels secure, she truly blossoms—showing her affectionate side, enjoying pats and cuddles, and leaning into the comfort of her humans with quiet trust. Out on walks, Katie is relaxed and easy-going. She enjoys sniffing, exploring, and taking in the world around her at a gentle pace. She walks nicely on lead and appreciates calm, reassuring guidance, making her a peaceful companion for everyday outings. Katie is happiest in environments where things feel calm and predictable, and she enjoys her space when meeting new dogs. She prefers gentle, respectful interactions and thrives best when she can take things slowly and feel secure in her surroundings. Travelling is no trouble for Katie—she settles well and relaxes comfortably, taking in new environments with quiet composure. Katie would suit a calm and caring home where she can continue to build confidence and enjoy gentle companionship. She would love a family who understands her need for a little time to settle, appreciates her soft and affectionate nature, and enjoys sharing quiet, peaceful moments together. A steady, supportive home will allow her loving personality to truly shine. With her gentle heart, sweet nature, and quiet charm, Katie is ready to find a home where she can feel safe, loved, and cherished. If you’re looking for a soft, affectionate companion to grow a beautiful bond with, Katie is ready to meet you.

NAME: Theo
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Theo 🐾 Cool, confident, and effortlessly laid-back, Theo is a handsome fawn greyhound who takes life in his stride with an easygoing, low-fuss charm. He has a relaxed, steady presence and a quiet self-assurance that makes him a calm and grounding companion to be around. Theo is comfortable in his own company and enjoys life at a relaxed pace. He’s happy to get pats and enjoys attention, but he’s equally content to settle nearby and simply relax, making him a wonderfully easy companion to have around the home. Out on walks, Theo is a confident explorer. He walks with purpose at the end of the lead, enjoying sniffing, investigating, and taking in his surroundings at his own steady rhythm. He is relaxed and easy in new environments, making him a straightforward and enjoyable walking partner. Theo travels well and settles quickly, taking everything in with a calm and unbothered attitude. Whether at home or on the move, he brings a steady, easy presence wherever he goes. Theo would suit a home that appreciates his independent, relaxed personality and enjoys a dog who is happy to simply be part of the household. He would thrive as the only dog in the home, where he can enjoy all the love, attention, and companionship of his people. This setup allows his calm confidence and easygoing nature to shine, creating a strong and rewarding bond with his family. He’s a great match for someone looking for a peaceful, uncomplicated companion who enjoys a steady, predictable routine. With his laid-back nature, steady temperament, and easy charm, Theo is ready to find a home where he can settle in and enjoy life at his own pace. If you’re looking for a relaxed, independent companion, Theo is ready to meet you.

NAME: Poppi
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Poppi 🐾 Soft, sweet, and quietly confident, Poppi is a young black greyhound with a gentle charm and an easy, relaxed way of moving through the world. She has a lovely balanced nature — affectionate and people-focused, with a calm confidence that makes her a pleasure to have around.
