She absolutely loves playing with her squeaky toys, going for short sniffari-style walks and wriggling her way on to your lap for snuggles! Autumn is well behaved indoors and doesn't mind spending a few hours alone during the day, making her a good match for apartment/unit (no stairs please!) dwellers who are looking for a companion to spend time with after work. She would also suit respectful kids who enjoy a fun, sweet dog. She is more of a people dog and would prefer not to share her new home with other animals. She would like all the love and attention for herself! Beautiful Autumn will love you for more than just the season - she will be your bestie for life! Apply online to take her home.

NAME: Barbie
TEXT: *I am in foster care & available to adopt!* Update from foster: "Barbie's been such a little love bug. She has been roaching absolutely everywhere, one of the quickest fosters we've had to get comfortable enough to sprawl out and relax, doing so in less than a week. She loves being close to her people and will happily follow you around the house throughout the day. Once she feels comfortable, she becomes incredibly affectionate, curling up beside you on the sofa, cuddling in close, and happily joining you for naps. Barbie is also a very curious girl. She wants to sniff everything, investigate everything, and always know what’s going on. She has a talent for accompanying you in task that doesn’t require a greyhound in the cutest possible way. She’s funny, outgoing, and full of personality. Whether she wants to go outside, have dinner, get some cuddles, or simply ask for attention, she'll happily let you know. I think Barbie would suit someone looking for a loving, affectionate companion with a personality who’ll make you laugh. She would likely thrive in a home where someone works from home, is around regularly, or is willing to continue building her confidence with being alone little by little. She's also doing very well with toilet training. She understands routines and timing well, and is generally very good at going outside when given regular opportunities." Meet Barbie at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Gibbs
TEXT: Hi, I'm Gibbs! I've been around kids, dogs and have some in home experience. You might be wondering what I've been getting up to? I have spent some time in a foster care home getting ready to meet you, have met livestock, children, a cattle dog, too. I am a sweet boy, a toy lover, and also a people lover! I would love my family to be home more often than not. I promise to walk perfectly on lead for our adventures, but let's make them short and sweet while I'm settling in as I haven't seen a lot of the world yet. I would suit a home with older kids, and my best suited home is one with another doggie to keep me company, especially if you're out of the home more often than not. I have shown I can work up to longer hours alone though so some practise and patience will see me thrive! Come and meet me at Londonderry's Adoption Centre.

NAME: Nelly
TEXT: *Nelly has just finished up a successful foster care placement!* Nelly is a gentle, sensitive soul who is just waiting for the right home to help her truly blossom. While she may be a little shy when meeting new people, once she gets to know you she becomes incredibly sweet, affectionate, and loyal. Nelly is looking for a quiet, calm house or apartment forever home where she can settle into pet life at her own pace. Busy households or lots of noise can feel overwhelming for her, so she would thrive in a peaceful environment with patient adopters who understand that confidence takes time to grow. She has been doing well with consistency in foster care. Because of her sensitive nature, Nelly's ideal home is with an adult-only household or older children aged 16+ with dog experience. She needs a predictable, calm environment to feel safe and secure. She would also really benefit from having a friendly, confident canine companion. A doggy friend could help show her the ropes, build her confidence, and encourage her to relax. Once she feels safe, Nelly settles beautifully indoors and is a huge fan of the couch and resting indoors. Snuggling up for a cozy evening is one of her favorite things! She’s the perfect companion for someone who enjoys quiet nights in, gentle walks, and sharing their home (and sofa!) with a loving best friend. If you have a calm home, a kind heart, and maybe even a friendly resident dog, Nelly could be the perfect addition to your family. Nelly is available via appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Neptune
TEXT: *I am in foster care* Introducing our special, beautiful blue boy Neptune, also known as Nepi, Nippy and Good Boy! Neptune has been in foster care for a few months. When Neptune first came home, he was very shy. He has come out of his shell slowly, and requires ongoing confidence building and an owner who will be his champion, protector and advocate. We are looking for a home with another dog for Neptune and a family who can love Neptune for the journey of confidence building that he is on. He would suit a house with a yard/outdoor space so he can flee the scene when needed. He is now coping with all things pet life, and growing everyday. He can be left for full time hours outdoors, he prefers now to sleep indoors, after initially being too scared to come inside. He doesn't bark and loves to be inside - only if you are with him. He was quite reluctant to be touched, but now loves pats, and stands next to you for back scratches. When he meets new people, his foster carer asks Neptune to decide whether he wants them to pat him. In everything, his foster carer allows it to be his decision and at his pace. Neptune loves food, prefers to eat outside on his own, and loves his after breakfast treat every morning of chicken fillet jerky. He knows the word “treat”! He also loves brisket bones. He gets a lot of confidence from other greyhounds and even smaller dogs. Loves being around them. He is very sweet and gentle natured. If you are someone loving, compassionate, who shows empathy, patience and understanding, who will love our very special boy, we know he will make the most loving and loyal companion. His foster carer has loved him unconditionally and he loves her back. If you are an experienced greyhound/experienced shy dog owner, with another doggie companion for Neptune to thrive with, please get in touch! You can meet Neptune and his foster carer at Western Sydney.

NAME: Jess
TEXT: *I'm in a foster care home* Jess is a sweet and affectionate female greyhound who forms strong connections with people and genuinely enjoys human companionship. She is highly social and readily seeks interaction, often approaching with a wagging tail and a friendly, engaging demeanour. Jess responds well to her name and happily checks in with her people, making her an enjoyable and rewarding companion to spend time with. Jess is a loving, people-oriented greyhound with a gentle and sensitive temperament. She would be best suited to a quieter home environment where she can feel secure. She would also benefit from being the only animal in the home, allowing her to fully relax, build confidence, and focus her affectionate nature on her human companions. With patience, understanding, and the companionship she clearly enjoys, Jess has all the qualities needed to become a devoted and affectionate family member. Meet Jess at Western Sydney

NAME: Bingo
TEXT: Bingo is a male greyhound with a calm and independent nature who enjoys taking in the world around him. He is naturally curious about his environment and tends to spend his time exploring, observing, and investigating new surroundings. While he may not immediately seek out human interaction, he becomes increasingly relaxed as he settles and gains confidence in his environment. Around small dogs, Bingo has shown appropriate social skills and good self-control. He may initially display curiosity and interest, particularly when first noticing a smaller dog, but he settles quickly as he gathers information. Bingo also displays polite manners around medium and large dogs. He is capable of offering gentle greetings and then moving on without lingering, demonstrating a balanced and respectful social style. Overall, Bingo is a thoughtful, easy-going greyhound who combines quiet independence with gentle social skills. As he becomes comfortable in new situations, his relaxed and steady temperament shines through. He would suit a home that appreciates his calm nature and allows him the freedom to explore, observe, and settle into family life at his own pace. With time and patience, Bingo is likely to become a loyal and rewarding companion. Meet Bingo in Western Sydney.

NAME: Jade
TEXT: Jade is a polite, social, affectionate and loving girl. She shows off her beautiful personality around new people, greeting everyone with a happy smile. She is friendly around other dogs and is best suited to a home with medium or large size dogs. She is a confident girl who would enjoy a home with respectful kids and a backyard to play in. Jade is a beautiful, happy and engaged girl who can't wait to meet you! Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Copper
TEXT: Copper is a lovely, gentle and easy going greyhound with quiet & calm approach to the world around him. This semi-roman nosed boy is an absolute gentleman. He enjoys exploring at his own pace and shows a natural curiosity, spending time investigating new environments through sniffing and quiet observation. His social style is respectful and measured, preferring calm interactions over boisterous play. Copper's ability to remain relaxed around other dogs and indoor cats, and would be suitable in a multi-pet household with canine or feline buddies. Respectful/quiet kids would also be a great match. If you're a family looking for a laid back companion, meet him at Western Sydney by appointment.

NAME: Rana
TEXT: Meet Rana! Rana is a gentle and sensitive female greyhound who approaches the world with a quiet and thoughtful nature. She can be cautious in unfamiliar situations and prefers to take her time becoming comfortable with new environments, people, and experiences. Rather than rushing into things, Rana carefully observes her surroundings and gains confidence gradually as she feels safe and supported. She enjoys exploring at her own pace, often taking in her environment through calm investigation and sniffing. While initially reserved, Rana remains close to her handler and appears to take comfort from having a familiar person nearby. Her gentle demeanour and soft nature suggest she will benefit from a patient home that allows her to settle in and build trust on her own terms. Rana is a kind-hearted and sensitive greyhound who will thrive in a calm and understanding home. With patience, gentle guidance, and time to settle, she is likely to develop into a loyal and affectionate companion. Her polite nature, gentle social skills, and quiet presence make her a lovely candidate for a family seeking a sweet and thoughtful greyhound to welcome into their lives. Meet Rana at Western Sydney

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Meet Bear! Bear is a gentle and thoughtful nature boy who is gradually learning to navigate new environments with confidence. He is a little shy when meeting new people but warms up quickly and will approached when called, as he becomes more familiar with those around him, his confidence grows and his relaxed, easy-going nature begins to shine through. He has demonstrated lovely manners around other dogs and appears to enjoy canine company. Bear is polite in his interactions, showing interest without being overbearing, and is able to move on calmly after greeting. His body language is generally relaxed and appropriate, particularly around larger dogs and other greyhounds. Overall, Bear is a sweet, gentle companion with a calm temperament and polite social skills. He would be well suited to a home that understands his sensitive nature and provides him with the time and encouragement to build confidence. In return, Bear offers a quiet, affectionate presence and all the makings of a wonderful family companion. Meet Bear at Western Sydney

NAME: Harper
TEXT: Harper is a friendly, affectionate girl who loves people, pats, and being part of family life. After spending the past year living as a much-loved pet on a farm, she's ready to find her forever home. She enjoys walks with the family, including outings with young children, and is equally happy joining Mum for a run. Harper has great manners around livestock and can calmly walk past chickens and ducks on lead without becoming over-excited. Harper gets along well with other dogs, including a retired greyhound, a Blue Heeler and a Mini Schnauzer. She loves toys, backyard playtime, visitors, and car trips. With her gentle nature, playful spirit, and love of companionship, Harper is ready to become a family favourite or someone's perfect best friend. ❤️🐾

NAME: May
TEXT: May is a happy, affectionate girl who loves people and will happily come up to you for pats and cuddles. She enjoys spending time with her family and her sweet nature makes her a wonderful companion and a joy to have around. May loves playing in the backyard, especially when there's a ball involved! She has enjoyed spending time with grandchildren aged 10–12 years and has also been around a 2-year-old child with supervision. She would fit beautifully into a family environment or make a loyal companion for someone looking for a loving friend, on her own or with another grey or small dog, getting along nicely with Mini Schnauzer. May travels well, walks nicely on lead, and takes life's adventures in her stride. With her affectionate personality and easy-going nature, May is ready to bring happiness and companionship to her new home.

NAME: Strike
TEXT: Meet Strike, a very friendly, easy-going boy with a lovely nature and a happy outlook on life. He enjoys spending time with people and is always ready for a pat, some attention, and a bit of fun. How handsome he is with his tuxedo markings and white paws 🐾🐾🤍🖤 Strike has spent time playing in the backyard with children aged 9 and 12, and he loves joining in the fun. He'll happily have a burst of energy, enjoy a game or a zoom around the yard, and then settle down for a well-earned rest. He's the perfect mix of playful and relaxed, and gets along with small and big dogs alike. When he's not playing, Strike is content to potter around beside you, keeping you company as you go about your day. His calm, affectionate personality makes him an easy dog to have around and a wonderful companion to brighten your day.

NAME: Helena
TEXT: Meet Helena 💖 Helena is a gentle, calm girl who is ready to find a loving home of her own. Sweet-natured and affectionate, she loves nothing more than receiving pats, scratches, cuddles, and the occasional kiss from her favourite people. Helena is very friendly and easy-going, getting along well with other greyhounds and small dogs alike. She's a pleasure to walk, is good on lead, and enjoys relaxed strolls around the neighbourhood. She has also been around children and takes it all in her stride with her calm, gentle nature. Having spent time in a backyard environment, Helena has adapted well to pet life and is happiest simply being part of the family. She's not looking for anything fancy, just a comfy bed, plenty of love, and a home where she can enjoy being a cherished companion. 🐾

NAME: Doc
TEXT: Doc is a friendly young boy, calm and quieter than his brother Buddy. He has an affectionate nature and loves a pat but does not like water as much and will avoid the mud puddles. He likes to keep himself clean! Doc loves a play in the yard with his brother and two mini fox terriers. They lie down and rest together, even eating with the little dogs. He is also not fazed about the pet ferrets in cages in the yard. He is good on the lead and loves to be walked by the grandkids 10, 12 and 17 years old in the park, plus a 2 year old in a pram. When not having a walk or play, Doc enjoys a rest in the yard or sometimes in the laundry on a cooler day. He would make a wonderful, loving pet for many households, including a family with older kids. He would like a walk a day and yard play but is not over-energetic, and he likes to have someone around or another dog.

NAME: Dot
TEXT: 🤍 Meet Dot! Dot is a gentle soul with a sweet and thoughtful nature. She can be a little reserved when faced with new environments or unfamiliar people, preferring to quietly observe before her confidence begins to shine through. With patience and understanding, Dot forms strong bonds and becomes a loyal companion. She absolutely loves her walks and enjoys spending time exploring alongside her people. Dot would be best suited to a calm, quiet home with a patient family who can give her the time and reassurance she needs to settle in and flourish. 🐾

NAME: Princess
TEXT: 👑 Meet Princess! Princess is a fun-loving girl with a bubbly personality and a heart full of affection. A true social butterfly, she loves making new friends and thrives on human companionship. Confident and outgoing, she's comfortable navigating stairs and enjoys exploring her surroundings. Princess would be best suited to an active home with a backyard where she can stretch her legs, play, and be part of the family adventures. With her sweet nature and zest for life, she's sure to bring plenty of joy to her new home.

NAME: Cliff
TEXT: Meet Cliff! 🐾 Cliff is a playful, fun-loving boy who brings plenty of joy wherever he goes. Curious and social, he loves engaging with both people and toys and is always keen to be part of the action. He enjoys his walks, exploring new surroundings, and having a good run around when given the chance. The backyard is Cliff's little oasis, where he can play, sniff, and enjoy the outdoors. After the fun is done, he's just as happy to kick back, relax, and enjoy a well-earned snooze. With his friendly personality and balanced nature, Cliff would make a wonderful companion for a lucky family.

NAME: Layla
TEXT: Meet Layla! 🐾 Layla is a very energetic and affectionate girl who loves being around her people. Full of enthusiasm for life, she enjoys staying active and is always ready for fun, playtime, or an adventure. Her loving nature makes her a wonderful companion, and she's sure to thrive in a home where she can be included in family life. With her energy levels, Layla would be best suited to an active family or younger couple with a secure backyard where she can stretch her legs and enjoy plenty of exercise.

NAME: Rhys
TEXT: Meet Rhys! 🐾 Rhys is a sweet-natured boy who is looking for a patient and understanding home where he can settle in at his own pace. While he may take a little time to find his feet, once he's comfortable you'll discover a loyal companion who loves being part of the family. Rhys will do best with older kids. With kindness, patience, and plenty of reassurance, Rhys will blossom into your very best mate, rewarding you with his gentle nature and unwavering companionship.

NAME: Darcy
TEXT: Meet Darcy! 🐾 Darcy is a happy, easy-going boy who loves nothing more than spending time with his people. He's great on walks, making him a wonderful companion for daily adventures, and he's always happiest when he's by your side. Darcy is a clever lad who comes when called by name and enjoys being involved in whatever you're up to. With his friendly nature and loyal personality, he's ready to find a home where he can share plenty of love, companionship, and happy moments.

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Meet Timmy! 🐾 Timmy is a playful, happy boy who loves being involved in whatever you're doing. He enjoys sticking by your side and makes a wonderful companion, whether you're heading out for a stroll or relaxing at home. Easy to walk on the lead,, Timmy has a cheerful nature that's sure to bring a smile to your face. With his friendly personality and loyal spirit, he's ready to become someone's very best mate🐶

NAME: AJ
TEXT: AJ is a gentle greyhound looking for a calm and understanding home where he can enjoy life's simple pleasures. With a quiet nature and a love for routine, AJ is searching for experienced dog owners who can provide him with the stability and support he needs to thrive. AJ is greyhound social and enjoys the company of other greyhounds out and about, but he would prefer to be the only dog in the home where he can relax and enjoy all the attention to himself. A calm household with a predictable routine would suit AJ best. He isn't looking for a busy social calendar and would be happiest in a home where he can enjoy a peaceful lifestyle without needing to venture out frequently. A comfortable place to rest, a secure yard, and a family who appreciates a quieter companion are at the top of AJ's wish list. AJ is suitable for a home with full-time working hours, provided his needs are met and he has a comfortable environment to settle into throughout the day. Due to his preference for a calm and predictable lifestyle, AJ is seeking an adult-only home. He would also benefit from adopters who have previous dog ownership experience and can confidently support him as he settles into retirement. If you're looking for a loyal companion to share a relaxed lifestyle with, AJ may be the perfect addition to your home.

NAME: Obi Wan Kenobi
TEXT: This is Obi-Wan Kenobi — a brave Jedi knight using the Force to steal hearts across the adoption centre. Obi-Wan Kenobi loves his walkies and might even do a little happy dance when he sees his lead! Loves an adventure, making him a great fit for an active family who enjoy long walks through the galaxy. He is perfectly behaved indoors at the adoption centre. Gentle, affectionate, and loves chilling out, Obi has the quintessential greyhound personality — laid back with moments of playfulness. Obi-Wan Kenobi seeks a family who will respect his Jedi calmness but also embrace his playful side. He’s suited for homes with a peaceful vibe and a little space to run around. Apply for our special boy Obi — and may the peace, paws, and happiness be with you! 🌟🐾

NAME: Timmy
TEXT: Timmy is a handsome, charismatic blue brindle guy! Timmy has spent a short amout of time in a home and his carers have said he is a big cuddly teddy bear of a dog with a goofy side! He is a dream to walk on the lead, loves to collect his toys on his bed, is a quick learner and is hilarious when he plays with his squeaky toys. They found he loves to nap and relax and didn't mind being left alone up to 3 hours if he gets a nice sniffy walk beforehand, but would propably prefer a home where someone is around fairly often to keep him company. Timmy would be suitable to live with older/experienced kids, as Timmy can get excited and forget his size in the heat of the moment. He can live with another dog his size however he doesn't need the companionship. We have also noticed Timmy is a smart boy here at GAP HQ and loves his food. He can even do stairs! So come and meet Timmy at the Western Sydney adoption centre. He can't wait to meet you!

NAME: Bruce
TEXT: With a name like Bruce, you'd expect a true-blue Aussie character and this handsome greyhound doesn't disappoint. Easy-going, friendly, and always up for a stroll, Bruce has the kind of laid-back attitude that would fit right in at a backyard barbie or a lazy Sunday arvo. Bruce travels well in the car, walks beautifully on lead, and takes new experiences in his stride. He enjoys meeting people, happily stopping for a pat and a chat, and is especially social with other greyhounds and larger dogs, greeting them with enthusiastic tail wags. If you're looking for a loyal mate with a relaxed "she'll be right" outlook on life, Bruce could be the perfect addition to your family. Bruce is available at Western Sydney

NAME: Uno
TEXT: Uno is a unique and sensitive Greyhound looking for a special home that can appreciate him for exactly who he is. He is a quirky boy with a gentle nature who takes a little time to feel safe and comfortable in new environments and around unfamiliar people. While he may initially come across as shy and reserved, Uno begins to show his sweet personality once trust has been built at his own pace. Uno is searching for a calm, patient, and understanding home that can support his individual needs and allow him the time he requires to settle in and gain confidence. He thrives with gentle handling, consistency, and a quiet environment where he feels secure. Uno would be best suited to an adult-only household where life is calm and predictable. He is happy to coexist with other Greyhounds and may enjoy the quiet companionship of another calm canine friend. Uno may not be the kind of dog who rushes into new friendships, but for the right person willing to give him time and understanding, he has the potential to form a deeply rewarding bond. He is a truly special boy looking for someone who will see the beauty in his quiet and quirky nature. Find Uno at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rex
TEXT: Rex is a people-loving greyhound who thrives on attention and connection. If you’re looking for a companion who enjoys being part of your day and happily soaks up affection, Rex will be right by your side. He’s highly motivated by food, which makes him responsive and engaged, and he settles beautifully in his crate when it’s time to relax. While toys aren’t really his thing, human company certainly is. Rex has socialised well with other greyhounds and could share his home with a compatible medium to large canine friend, though he would be just as happy as the only dog. He would be suitable for a family with respectful children and has shown a calm and affectionate nature in his interactions with people. Rex has demonstrated that he settles best indoors and enjoys the comfort of home life. A townhouse with at least a small courtyard would be ideal, giving him a bit of outdoor space to stretch his legs and unwind. Initially, Rex may be best suited to a home where he has someone home more often than not, while he adjusts, but he has shown an encouraging ability to self-settle. With gradual progression and routine, his capacity can continue to build. Rex is a warm, affectionate boy who is ready to enjoy the comforts of pet life. With structure, guidance and plenty of love, he will make a devoted and rewarding companion.

NAME: Oaklee
TEXT: Oaklee is a happy, outgoing Greyhound with a playful spirit and a real zest for life. He loves spending time with people and thrives on interactive games, adventures, and new experiences. Wherever he goes, Oaklee brings fun, enthusiasm, and positive energy. While he enjoys staying active and making the most of every day, he also appreciates quiet moments to relax and unwind. With his friendly nature and balanced temperament, Oaklee is the perfect mix of playful companion and laid-back friend.

NAME: Vince
TEXT: Vince is a handsome male Greyhound with a confident and easy-going personality. He settles well into new environments and enjoys exploring his surroundings, taking everything in with curiosity and confidence. Whether he’s out on a walk or meeting new people, Vince carries himself with calm and polite manners. He walks beautifully on lead and is a pleasure to have by your side. Vince enjoys human interaction and happily approaches people for attention, often leaning in gently for a scratch and some affection. His friendly and relaxed nature makes him a lovely companion to spend time with. Vince would be best suited as the only animal in the home, where he can enjoy all the love, attention, and comfort for himself. He would thrive in a home that can continue providing him with companionship, routine, and opportunities to explore the world around him. With his confident personality, lovely manners, and affectionate nature, Vince is ready to become a loyal and cherished companion for a very lucky home. Meet Vince at Western Sydney.

NAME: Ritchie
TEXT: 🐾 Meet Ritchie 🐾 If you're looking for a gentle soul with a heart of gold, Ritchie may just be your perfect match. This handsome fawn Greyhound is a sweet, thoughtful boy who likes to take in the world at his own pace. With his calm nature and quiet charm, Ritchie has a lovely way of winning people over once he feels comfortable. Ritchie is the kind of dog who enjoys getting to know his people first. He's a gentle and sensitive companion who appreciates kindness and patience, and once he's settled in, he happily leans into affection and enjoys soft, gentle pats. There's something incredibly special about earning the trust of a dog like Ritchie, and watching his personality blossom is a truly rewarding experience. In everyday life, Ritchie is a calm and easy-going fellow. He walks beautifully on lead and enjoys exploring his surroundings, taking in all the interesting sights and smells around him. He travels well and is happy riding in the car, making him an easy companion for outings and adventures. Ritchie has lovely manners around other dogs. He greets small dogs politely before happily carrying on with his day, and he's comfortable sharing space with other Greyhounds. His relaxed and gentle approach makes him a pleasant canine companion. At around four and a half years old, Ritchie is in a wonderful stage of life where he enjoys both quiet downtime and leisurely adventures. He has a soft, reserved nature that gives him an especially endearing quality, and his handsome fawn coat only adds to his charm. Ritchie's ideal home would be one that offers a calm, patient environment where he can settle in at his own pace and continue building confidence. He would thrive with people who appreciate the quieter personalities in life and enjoy forming a special bond with their dog. A peaceful household with plenty of love, understanding, and gentle encouragement would suit him beautifully. If you're ready to welcome a sweet, loyal companion into your life, Ritchie is waiting to meet you and begin his next chapter by your side. 🐾💛

NAME: Kath
TEXT: Kath is a beautiful brindle girl with a happy-go-lucky outlook on life and a personality that’s sure to bring a smile to your face. Full of enthusiasm and charm, she has a wonderfully puppy-like nature despite being ready to leave her racing days behind and start her next chapter. Lively and energetic, and always keen to get out and about, Kath loves exploring the world alongside her people. She walks well on leash, enjoys her outings, and greets new experiences with curiosity and excitement. Meeting new people is one of her favorite things, and she’s always happy to make new friends wherever she goes. Kath does have a slight heart murmur that will require keeping an eye on but this doesn't effect her happy attitude or energy. Kath has shown an excellent reaction to a whippet and would suit a home looking for a friendly, social companion who enjoys both adventures and affection. Her cheerful nature, stunning brindle coat, and love of human company make her a truly special girl. If you’re looking for a loving companion who will happily join you on walks, outings, and everyday adventures, Kath could be the perfect match.

NAME: Rodger
TEXT: Rodger is a typical boy who likes his time looking after the yard, chasing balls and going on walks. He is also a sucker for a cuddle and some affection. He would also make a good supervisor for when you are in the yard.

NAME: Atlas
TEXT: Atlas is a handsome boy with a gentle nature and a heart that’s ready to bond deeply with his future family. While he can be a little nervous when meeting new people and situations, he is willing to engage and quickly shows his sweet personality once he feels comfortable. An owner-centred dog, Atlas loves having his people nearby and will thrive in a home where he can build a close connection with his new family. He is crate trained, enjoys the comfort of his own space, and settles well with a little patience and routine. Like many hounds, he can be a bit awkward at times, which only adds to his charm and lovable character. Atlas enjoys playtime, especially when a squeaky toy is involved, and has shown himself to be friendly and appropriate around a whippet. He is in good condition, travels well, and is ready to leave his racing days behind in search of a loving forever home. If you’re looking for a loyal companion who will reward your patience with unwavering affection and companionship, Atlas could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Frank
TEXT: Frank is a happy, friendly boy who is ready to find a family of his very own. With his good-natured personality and affectionate nature, he's sure to bring plenty of love and laughter to his future home. Frank enjoys spending time with people and is always happy to be part of the action. Whether it's joining you for outdoor adventures, relaxing in the yard, or simply hanging out with his family, Frank is happiest when he's included. Frank is medium to large dog friendly, pending a successful meet and greet. Frank would be best suited to a home with children aged 10 years and older who can respectfully interact with him and understand his boundaries. A home with a secure yard would be ideal for Frank, giving him space to stretch his legs, play, and enjoy the outdoors. He would thrive with a family that can provide regular exercise, companionship, and plenty of opportunities to be involved in daily life. Meet Frank at Western Sydney adoption centre

NAME: Hudson
TEXT: Hudson is a handsome boy who is ready to find a patient and understanding family to call his own. While he's still learning the ropes of pet life, Hudson is making great progress and would thrive in a home that can help him continue building his confidence. Hudson is M-L dog-friendly and would greatly benefit from having a calm, well-adjusted canine companion in the home. A friendly dog buddy can help show him the way, provide reassurance, and make settling into family life much easier. He would be best suited to a home with a secure yard where he can stretch his legs, enjoy some outdoor time, and explore his surroundings safely. A house with space to move around will help him feel comfortable and give him opportunities to exercise and unwind. In his new home, Hudson will benefit from a gradual settling-in period and a consistent routine. Initially, he'd do best with shorter periods alone while he adjusts to his surroundings. As his confidence grows and he becomes comfortable in his new environment, Hudson should be able to work up to spending longer periods on his own. If you're looking for a sweet dog who just needs a little guidance and a chance to shine, Hudson could be the perfect addition to your family.

NAME: Fran
TEXT: Meet Fran 🐾 Fran is a sweet, friendly, and very pretty greyhound who absolutely loves people. She has a warm, social nature and enjoys spending time with her humans as well as getting along nicely with small dogs. This lovely girl is a big fan of treats, which makes her a great candidate for ongoing training—and she may even enjoy learning a few fun tricks! Fran walks beautifully on the lead, making outings together a pleasure. She’s also a clean and quiet housemate, settling in nicely and bringing a calm, gentle presence to the home. With her affectionate personality and easygoing nature, Fran would make a wonderful companion for someone looking for a loving and well-mannered friend 💕

NAME: Dash
TEXT: Meet Dash 🐾 Dash is a handsome blue male greyhound and, quite simply, a very good boy. He has a playful and cheerful nature, always ready for some fun—especially when toys are involved! One of Dash’s cutest quirks is his love of carrying his bed around 😊 He likes to take it with him during the day, always very carefully, making sure he has the perfect spot ready for a cosy sleep at night. Dash is friendly and social, getting along well with both small dogs and other large dogs. He loves human company just as much and is always happy to soak up plenty of pats and attention. With his playful spirit, gentle heart, and easygoing nature, Dash would make a wonderful companion for a home looking for a fun and affectionate addition.

NAME: Min Min
TEXT: Meet Minnie (Min Min) 🐾 Minnie—affectionately known as Min Min—is a sweet and gentle girl who may be a little shy at first, but she quickly warms up to those who show her kindness and patience. Once she feels safe, her lovely personality shines through. She’s been living in an apartment-style environment and is a clean, easy housemate, making her a wonderful fit for indoor living. Minnie enjoys a little burst of zoomies to stretch her legs, then is more than happy to curl up in her bed and relax. She loves her walks, and Min Min loves a trip to the beach, where she can take in all the sights and smells. Minnie would thrive in a quiet home where she can feel secure and spend time with her people. With a bit of ongoing training and routine, Minnie has the potential to be comfortably left alone for a few hours at a time. If you’re looking for a gentle, loving companion who enjoys both a little fun and plenty of relaxation, Minnie could be the perfect match 💕

NAME: Boots
TEXT: Meet Boots 🐾 Boots is a slightly older and wiser female greyhound with a calm, gentle nature. She’s at a lovely stage of life where she’s settled, easygoing, and ready to enjoy the quiet comforts of a loving home. Boots would thrive in a peaceful environment and may be happiest as an only dog, where she can truly relax and enjoy her surroundings. She would make wonderful company for a retired single person or couple looking for a loyal, low-key companion. Affectionate and loving, Boots enjoys her downtime and would prefer a home without small, busy dogs who might disturb her well-earned rest. Don’t let her age fool you — Boots still has many years of love to share. If you’re looking for a sweet, settled girl to share your days with, Boots could be the perfect match 💜

NAME: Red
TEXT: Meet Red 🐾 Red is a beautiful blue male greyhound with a gentle heart. He can be a little shy at first, but with some patience and kindness, his sweet nature truly shines. Once he feels safe and comfortable, Red becomes a loyal and loving companion. He absolutely loves the company of other greyhounds and enjoys spending time with his favourite stuffed toy. While he’s very social with his own kind, small, yappy dogs can feel a bit overwhelming for him, so slow, thoughtful introductions are important. Red is looking for a calm, patient foster carer or adopter who can give him the time he needs to adjust to family life. With the right support and understanding, he will flourish into a devoted and affectionate friend. If you have a gentle home and a kind heart, Red would love to meet you 💙

NAME: Peppe
TEXT: Peppe is a gorgeous, very sweet 2 year old boy, ready for his next step! He’s a sweet, mostly confident, but due to his young age he can take time to process new situations, but he becomes more engaged as he settles. He’s polite with other greyhounds, offering calm sniffs before moving on and could live with another dog his size. He’s fine in the crate with a little encouragement and settles once inside. Peppe is a gentle boy who will thrive with consistency to build confidence and continue developing into a lovely pet. As he is young, he has a whole exciting life ahead of him and he can't wait to meet you! Meet Peppe at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bub
TEXT: Meet Bub! Say hello to Bub, a sweet-natured older girl who’s ready to enjoy the simple pleasures of retirement. Bub is looking for a quiet, peaceful home where she can soak up the sun, enjoy some gentle pats, and claim a soft, cosy bed as her own. With her graceful charm and soft eyes, Bub has a spring in her step, but she’s very low-maintenance when it comes to exercise – a short burst of energy in the yard, a few short strolls and a bit of backyard sunbathing are all she needs to be content. She would thrive as an only dog, but she’s also happy to share her space with a male greyhound companion. Bub is a great match for full-time workers if there’s a secure backyard where she can relax during the day. She would also suit a calm household with older children who respect her quiet nature. If you're after a gentle soul who’s past the puppy chaos and just wants to be your loyal companion, Bub might just be the girl you’ve been waiting for. ☀️ Loves: Sunbaking, soft beds, peaceful vibes 🏡 Best home: Quiet environment, backyard, solo or with a male greyhound 💙 Personality: Calm, sweet, gentle, quietly affectionate 🦴 Exercise needs: Minimal – a yard for a quick zoom, a gentle stroll, she’s more nap than zoom Let Bub bring serenity, love, and a little sparkle into your life.

NAME: Stanley
TEXT: Stanley is lovely, friendly, soft-natured boy who loves to cuddle. He has a quiet nature and just loves to be around you and check out what you're doing as you go about your day - a sticky beak! He is an easy-going, gentle lad who will be your best friend. Stanley is the perfect gentleman and companion for retirees or workers, he doesn't need much of a walk or trips in the car, he's just happy to hang about at home. Stanley isn’t an energetic boy, very easy-care who would make a wonderful pet, also great with the grandchildren 9 and 13 when they come to visit. 🐾💙

NAME: Jasper
TEXT: Jasper is a friendly and confident Greyhound who absolutely loves being around people. He thrives on affection and human interaction and is happiest when he’s included in everyday life with his family. Jasper enjoys being part of the action and will happily seek out attention and cuddles from his favourite humans whenever he gets the chance. With his social and outgoing nature, Jasper is a lovely companion to have around the home. He enjoys company and brings a warm, affectionate presence wherever he goes. His confidence and friendly personality make him an easy dog to bond with, and he loves feeling connected to the people around him. Jasper is social with other Greyhounds and would likely enjoy the companionship of another calm canine friend. He would benefit from a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax outdoors, and enjoy time with his family. Sweet, affectionate, and full of personality, Jasper is ready to find a loving home where he can continue being included, adored, and spoiled with all the attention he deserves. Meet Jasper at Western Sydney.

NAME: Rocky
TEXT: Rocky is a delightful young boy who adores spending time with his humans. Since arriving in foster care he has learnt that the lounge is the most comfortable place to sleep, that toys are super fun (especially giant caterpillars), is now taking stairs in his stride, and has most recently learnt to independently hop out of the car at the end of the trip (still needs some help getting in). He is also learning about his reflection in windows and mirrors and that animals on the tv won’t respond to his attempts to say hello. He wants to be friends with all dogs and cats that he meets and has enjoyed living with a 9 year old child. Cuddles on the couch and neighbourhood walks are enjoyed equally and he is happy with both short snaffari walks and longer adventures. Rocky would prefer someone in his future family to be home most of the day. While ok being alone for an hour or two, he can become distressed if his humans leave him alone while at school and work. He is a sweet, sensitive, playful and sensible dog who learns quickly. Rocky is a joy to have in your home. Rocky is a handsome boy with a sweet, confident personality and a love for being involved in everyday life. He currently lives in a home with a family with a cat. Rocky is social and well-mannered with both big and small dogs, as well as cats, making him a lovely companion for multi-pet homes. Shorter hours alone as a solo pet is best suited, or a home with longer hours with another dog present. Book in to meet Rocky at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bear
TEXT: Bear is a beautiful 3-year-old Greyhound with a calm, gentle nature. Bear is social around other dogs and could happily live with other Greyhounds or medium-sized dogs. He may also be able to live with smaller breed dogs if the match is right and introductions are handled slowly and thoughtfully. He walks very well on lead and enjoys getting out for daily strolls before returning home for a long nap and some quiet time with his family. A home with older children would suit Bear best, as he would appreciate a calm and respectful environment where he can feel comfortable and settled. He would also love a home with a secure backyard where he can stretch his legs, relax in the sunshine, and enjoy some outdoor time. Bear is a sweet, adaptable boy who has so much love to give. With his gentle temperament and lovely manners, he is ready to become a cherished member of a lucky family. Meet Bear by appointment at Western Sydney.

NAME: Noel
TEXT: Meet Noel 🐾 Noel is a true gentle giant with a heart as big as his long, lanky legs. This handsome boy is incredibly social and has quickly become a crowd favourite thanks to his friendly nature and easy-going personality. He loves meeting new people and is always happy to soak up plenty of pats and attention. Cool, calm, and collected, Noel takes most things in life in his stride. Whether it’s hopping into the car or even enjoying a train ride, he handles new experiences with confidence and ease, making him a wonderful companion for a variety of lifestyles. But every hero has their kryptonite—and for Noel, it’s stuffed toys! The moment he spots one, it’s game on, and his playful, determined side comes to life. It’s all business when a soft toy is involved, and it’s sure to bring a smile to your face. Noel would thrive in a home where he can be part of the action, surrounded by people who will give him the love and attention he adores. If you’re looking for a sociable, affectionate, and entertaining companion with a playful streak, Noel might just be your perfect match. 💙

NAME: Azzi
TEXT: 🤍 Meet Azzi Azzi is a beautiful older gentleman with the sweetest soul and a gentle nature that’s impossible not to love. He’s calm, affectionate and happiest simply spending time with his people, making him the perfect loyal companion to share your days with. Great with small dogs, Azzi has a kind and easy-going personality that would suit a home looking for a relaxed best friend. With his soft eyes and loving nature, this lovely boy is ready to enjoy the retired life full of comfort, companionship and plenty of love.

NAME: Jake
TEXT: Jake, also known as “Taw Commander,” is a striking young boy bursting with personality, enthusiasm, and charm. Extremely social with people, Jake thrives on human interaction and forms strong bonds with his handlers, listening well and loving being part of the action. A playful and energetic lad, Jake would suit an active home that can keep up with his zest for life. While he absolutely adores playtime, he can be a little unaware of his own size and strength, so he would be best matched with medium to large canine companions. He’s already proven himself capable of making great doggy friendships — his best mate is a Rottweiler! Jake has been acclimated to life inside the home and is looking for a family who will include him in their daily adventures, whether that’s walks, outings, or relaxing together after a fun-filled day. With his stunning looks, affectionate nature, and larger-than-life personality, Jake is sure to make an unforgettable companion.

NAME: Emma
TEXT: *I have just gone into foster care - updates coming soon!* Emma is a little in size and big on personality! She is bright, fun-loving and an affectionate. She thrives around people and is incredibly friendly with medium to large dogs, often enjoying their company so much that she would likely love a canine companion in her future home. Because Emma can get a little enthusiastic and excitable during play, any dog friend would need to be tolerant and easy-going. While she can be energetic, Emma also settles beautifully indoors once she has had the chance to exercise and unwind making her suitable for apartment living with an active lifestyle. Some hours alone are suitable as a solo pet but an outlet for enrichment and stimulation is best suited. Due to her lively nature, she would be best suited to older klds. Meet Emma at Western Sydney.

NAME: Arlo
TEXT: Arlo is an affectionate boy with a beautiful brindle coat. He’s a soft, social soul who adores being around people and thrives on gentle attention. At almost two years old, he’s in that perfect stage—playful and curious but already calm and well‑mannered. This sweet boy has a patient, gentle nature that makes him well-suited to families with children. He enjoys being involved in family life and loves soaking up pats, ear scratches, and cuddles from little humans. He also loves to play with other medium to large dogs. 🏡 Ideal Home Arlo would thrive in a home that: Enjoys daily walks, playtime, and plenty of affection Understands the needs of a young greyhound—soft beds, gentle routines, and occasional goofy antics ❤️ Why You’ll Love Him Arlo is all heart. He’s the kind of dog who bonds deeply, follows you with those big soulful eyes. Whether he’s snoozing in the sun, trotting happily beside a dog buddy, or leaning in for a cuddle, Arlo brings warmth and joy everywhere he goes.

NAME: Foxy
TEXT: Foxy is a happy, playful and handsome blue boy with a big heart and an even bigger love for pats and cuddles. He enjoys his walks and is great on the lead, making him a lovely companion for an active family. Foxy has spent time both indoors and outdoors and been around the family children aged 9 and 12 years daily, as well as the 2.5-year-old under supervision. He’s friendly and social with other dogs too, getting along well with a pet dachshund, a pointer, and other greyhounds. Tigress has been his yard mate. With his affectionate nature, playful personality, and easy-going temperament, Foxy would suit a family looking for a fun, loving companion to include in everyday life.

NAME: Louie
TEXT: Louie is a gentle, low maintenance, laid back and quiet soul. If you're looking for a laid back senior greyhound, Louie might be perfect for you. Louie enjoys life in the slow lane and is looking for someone to spend quiet time with. Louie is a lovely greyhound who loves mingling with other dogs his size, settles well alone and would love a home with indoor outdoor access where he can independently alternate between exploring outside and resting on beds indoors. A solo pet home is best suited. He is suitable with older/respectful kids and dreams of a backyard/courtyard to snooze in. He would like a flat home without stairs, as he is still learning how to navigate staircases. Louie is a sweet gentleman and he hopes you come to meet him soon. Meet Louie at Western Sydney.

NAME: Tokyo
TEXT: Tokyo is a stunning girl with a gentle soul. Initially shy, once she learns to trust you she forms a beautiful bond and looks to her favourite person for comfort and companionship. She loves stretching her legs and zooming around open spaces, but is equally happy curling up on the couch for a peaceful afternoon. Tokyo would thrive in a calm, quiet home with someone patient enough to let her blossom at her own pace. In return, she’ll reward you with loyalty, affection, and her striking good looks.

NAME: Rusty (Western Sydney)
TEXT: Rusty is a gentle soul with a quiet nature and a heart that slowly but surely opens once he feels safe and comfortable. Rusty’s love of snacks definitely shines through once he feels relaxed and confident around you. Rusty would thrive in a calm and predictable household with older children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs while settling in. He would also benefit from living with a calm medium large breed dog( 15kg+)or another greyhound, as the company of a steady canine friend helps him feel more secure and confident. Behind his quiet exterior is a sweet, affectionate boy who simply wants to feel safe, loved, and included. For the right home, Rusty will become a devoted and loving companion who will be by your side every step of the way. Meet Rusty in Western Sydney.

NAME: Eddy
TEXT: Eddy is a sweet, gentle and quiet boy looking for a family to thrive in. He might be going a little grey in the face but he is full of cuddles, life and happiness and can't wait to have a family to share his life with. He warms up with those he's confident with and would do best with a backyard/courtyard for sunbaking and sniffing the breeze with the occasional zoomie. He would suit a home with respectful/quiet kids and even a doggie friend or two! Eddy hasn't seen a lot of the world yet and would thrive with a home who is looking to show him all things pet life. He is very eager to please, friendly and sweet... Eddy can't wait to meet you and become a beloved family pet! Eddy is available at the Western Sydney adoption centre.

NAME: Jackson

NAME: Mumbles

TEXT: Meet Freddy 😄 The fun-loving goofball guaranteed to keep you smiling. NAME: Chubbs
TEXT: Meet Chubbs 💙 Chubbs is a gentle soul with a beautiful smile and an even sweeter personality to match. With his sweet nature and easy-going personality, Achilles would make a wonderful companion and could also live with small dogs.

NAME: Umar
TEXT: Umar is a confident and outgoing greyhound with a fun-loving personality and a zest for life. He enjoys being part of the action and is always eager to explore his surroundings, making him a wonderful companion for an active household. As a strong and enthusiastic walker, Umar will benefit from a family who can continue guiding him on lead and enjoy getting out and about with him. He thrives in environments where he has space to move, so a home with secure yard access would suit him perfectly. Whether he’s stretching his legs outdoors or taking in the world around him, Umar enjoys keeping busy and being involved in daily life. Umar is social and comfortable around people, happily spending time alongside his humans, although he tends to show his affection in a more independent and relaxed way. He enjoys companionship without being overly demanding and would suit a home that appreciates his easy-going nature. With his bright personality, confident outlook, and active spirit, Umar is looking for a home that will enjoy all the wonderful qualities he has to offer while giving him the space and lifestyle where he can truly thrive. You can meet Umar in Western Sydney.

NAME: Alvin
TEXT: Alvin is a gentle and sensitive greyhound looking for a quiet and calm household where he can relax and feel safe. With his quiet nature and sweet personality, Alvin would thrive in a peaceful household with a family who appreciates the softer side of life. He would be best suited to a home with a secure yard where he can stretch his legs, lounge in the sunshine, and enjoy his own space. Alvin enjoys relaxing and is happiest in an environment that is calm and predictable. While Alvin can be a little shy when meeting new people, with patience and kindness he gradually warms up and shows his affectionate and gentle nature. He is a quiet, timid boy initially, but once he feels comfortable, he becomes a lovely companion who enjoys simply being near his people. Because Alvin can be shy around young children, he would be best matched with a household with older children or adults only. A quieter home environment will help him continue to build confidence and feel secure. If you are looking for a calm, sweet-natured companion who enjoys a relaxed lifestyle and just needs a little time to blossom, Alvin could be the perfect addition to your family. Alvin is at Western Sydney.

NAME: Dua
TEXT: Meet Dua — a sweet, sensitive soul with a goofy streak that will keep you smiling every day. Initially a little shy, Dua quickly shows her true colours once she feels safe: affectionate, funny, playful, and always ready for a cuddle with her favourite human. Too slow for the racing world but perfectly suited to family life, Dua still loves to zoom around the yard and entertain everyone with her silly energy and lovable personality. She enjoys exploring new environments with a trusted companion by her side and is a very clever girl who likes to keep herself busy. Dua is searching for a calm, quiet home where she can truly relax and enjoy the simple things in life. She would thrive with another calm dog for company and companionship. Due to her impressive problem-solving skills and history of finding creative escape routes just to visit her hound friends, Dua will require a secure, fully fenced yard. If you’re looking for a loyal best friend who will make you laugh, snuggle close on the couch, and bring endless love into your life, Dua may just be your perfect match.

NAME: Charlie
TEXT: Charlie is a sweet, dog social boy with a sweet personality to match his handsome looks. His happy personality is hard not to fall in love with, and he would suit a home with respectful kids. He lights up every room he enters with his infectious energy and signature grin. Whether he’s heading out for a walk, playing with his favourite toys, or simply soaking up attention, Charlie approaches life with enthusiasm and charm. NAME: Henry
TEXT: Henry is a confident, goofy greyhound with a big personality and an even bigger love for people and has spent time around children and small dogs. He’s friendly, affectionate, and always keen for pats, sniffy walks, and hanging out with his humans. He travels beautifully in the car, settles calmly in a crate, and is generally an easy-going lad. Henry absolutely LOVES other greyhounds and would suit a playful dog companion, big or small. He’s social, gentle and full of cheeky charm. Henry is ready to find a home full of comfy couches, snacks, and a family to adore him. Meet Henry at Western Sydney.

NAME: Bolt
TEXT: Bolt is a gentle, sweet-natured greyhound with a soft soul and plenty of love to give. While he can be a little reserved when first meeting new people, it doesn’t take long for his affectionate side to come through once he feels comfortable. He’s the kind of dog who builds strong bonds with his people and absolutely blossoms in a calm, supportive environment. He would thrive in a home with a calm medium to large breed dog to keep him company and to build his confidence. Bolt is wonderful to walk and has lovely lead manners, making outings together an easy and enjoyable part of the day. He would be happiest in a home with older children who can respect his gentle nature and give him the space he needs to settle in at his own pace. For someone willing to give him a little time and reassurance, Bolt will reward them with trust, loyalty, and the quiet kind of love that feels extra special because it’s earned. Available at Western Sydney.

NAME: Em-Jay
TEXT: Meet Em-Jay - a happy, smoochy boy with a gentle nature and a love for ear scratches and pats. He enjoys a good run around the backyard, but he’s mostly a quiet, easygoing companion who’s happiest relaxing nearby, playing in his shell pool, or simply enjoying the day with his people. Em-Jay loves his street walks and takes in the world at his own pace. He can be a little shy when meeting new people, but once he gets to know you, he’s very happy to soak up affection and attention. Having lived a quiet life in a rural town, Em-Jay would suit a calm home where he can enjoy companionship, downtime, and being part of everyday life - whether that’s gardening, pottering around the yard, or relaxing at home together. He’s happy as an only dog or could live with a calm female dog, such as a Whippet. With his sweet nature, loving smooches, and gentle companionship, Em-Jay is ready to find a home where he can truly belong.

NAME: Kermit
TEXT: Meet Kermit — a loving and affectionate grey with a big personality and an adventurous spirit. NAME: Chewy
TEXT: Meet Chewy — a confident and engaging grey who navigates the world with calm curiosity and an easygoing nature. With her confident temperament, gentle curiosity, and engaging personality, Chewy is sure to make a wonderful companion for a family looking for a loyal and easygoing grey to share life with.

NAME: Jane
TEXT: Meet Jane — a shy but absolutely adorable girl with a gentle nature and a calm, sweet personality. NAME: Duke
TEXT: Meet this gentle boy — a sweet and sensitive grey who is looking for a patient and caring adopter to help him feel safe and settled in his new home. NAME: Ernie
